segments.normalizedSource: ```swift func createLibrary(_ device: MTLDevice, libraryName: String) -> MTLLibrary? { let libraryURL = Bundle.main.url(forResource: libraryName, withExtension: "metallib") guard let libraryURL else { print("Couldn't find library file: \(libraryName)"); return nil; } let library: MTLLibrary do { library = try device.makeLibrary(URL: libraryURL) } catch { print("Couldn't find library file: \(libraryName)"); print("Error descriotion: \(error.localizedDescription)") return nil } return library } ```
